fact: The data-protection authority (APD) issued deliberation 005/2025 on minimum conditions for using cloud services abroad, requiring public- and private-sector data controllers to obtain APD authorisation before processing personal data on foreign cloud services and to include contract clauses on legal compliance, data transfer, data return on expiry and permanent deletion; the document publishes the amended text on 2026-04-30 and dates the original meeting 2025-07-30.

The APD's monthly meeting of 29 April 2026 had on its agenda the approval of amendments to some articles of deliberation 2025/005 on minimum conditions for outsourcing to the cloud abroad, and the members took decisions on the agenda items without the minute stating the amended wording.

The data protection authority (APD) issued deliberation 005/2025 on 30 July 2025, requiring public and private data controllers that use cloud services located abroad to obtain prior APD authorisation and to include set clauses (compliance with law 2017-020, foreign-transfer clause, data retrieval and permanent deletion) in the provider contract.
